# Learning Voyage

Learning Voyage LLC is Owen Onderdonk's independent practice and professional home for AI data, evaluation, research operations, data partnerships, proprietary-data systems, and agent environments.

## Owen Onderdonk

Owen is an AI Data & Evaluation Program Lead with experience progressing from complex mathematics training-data creation to reviewer, reviewer oversight, project development, program management, and general operations for frontier-model data programs.

## Flagship public work

AutoQA Foundation: https://autoqa-foundation.vercel.app/
Case study: https://learning.voyage/work/autoqa-foundation.html

AutoQA Foundation is a public decision and technical framework defining the capability and authority boundaries of LLM-based quality review. It distinguishes supported, contradicted, insufficient, and contract-ambiguous outcomes and requires lane-level measurement before automated findings receive consequential authority.
